preparationBase: Suikaloi 700 g kuorittua juuriselleriä ja 55 g sipulia. Voitele vuoka osalla punnitusta 28 g voita; käytä loput voi nokareina ruoan päällä.
Lado juuriselleri, sipuli ja 125 g valutettuja öljyyn säilöttyjä anjovisfileitä vuokaan. Lisää 250 g 38 % kuohukermaa, 100 g täysmaitoa ja 0,5 g mustapippuria.
Kypsennä 200 °C:ssa kunnes juuriselleri on pehmeää. Lisää 8 g tilliä ja jaa koko vuoka nesteineen neljään annokseen.

holds.newResearchQuestionAndOutcome: GI80 is a specific40-minute jasmine porridge; published60-minute congee is not the same preparation. Could prepare exact40-minute version, but current AFCD dry-rice A and sesame-oil/stock sources also need explicit identities. No automatic use of GI31 black-rice/coconut mixed porridge.

New full-table check resolves GI identity: row1799 is explicitly BOILED BUTTERNUT GI51±6,n10,not a generic pumpkin mean. Recipe says butternut rather than kabocha, so retain that name. Exact butternut available-CHO composition independent of AFCD polyol issue remains unclosed. Coconut200ml/2 using official Clearspring3.4g/100ml yields3.4g totalCHO/serving and fails omission; Fineli29014 CHOAVL is an alternative frozen composition proxy requiring an explicit bound version, not a density0.92 shortcut. Rice40min steaming vs published simmered porridge also needs reconciliation. No whole GK yet.

New source check found that GI53 row1092 is Canadian wild blueberry, not Finnish forest bilberry and not automatically cultivated highbush blueberry Fineli35596. Fineli35596 now supplies independent CHOAVL12.52, but does not establish species/preparation GI.50g/4 gives1.565g A/serving, beyond omission. Raw strawberries can use named GI40, but do not publish partial bowl.
